title: Wire selectable vector backend runtime

context.summary: Expose pgvector and Qdrant as real selectable vector backends.
context.background: Both backends must be selectable from config, installer, worker and search runtime with consistent results.

in: Add vector backend config and installer choices for pgvector and Qdrant.
Wire API search and worker indexing to the selected backend.
Add acceptance for pgvector and Qdrant with matching source refs.
Remove TASK-91-owned public-readiness debt from the gate.
out: Adding third-party vector stores beyond Qdrant.

acceptance_criteria: Runtime selects pgvector or Qdrant from validated config.
Worker indexing writes to the selected backend.
Search responses have consistent shape across both backends.
Installer can configure Qdrant profile and healthcheck it.

manual_checks: Confirm pgvector remains the default backend.
Confirm Qdrant config is not present as an unused dead setting.

risks: Backend selection must not create split-brain indexing between Postgres and Qdrant.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
